clue.text: Wonderful news about alumnus who was poorly hidden?

blocks.note: OB, old boy, is a former pupil of a school
good news of a patient who was ill: he's cured, written with the apostrophe s

explanation.surface: A school newsletter cheers the recovery of a former pupil who had been ill.
explanation.walkthrough: The wonderful news is literally the sentence OB'S CURED, the old boy has recovered; run together it spells OBSCURED.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obscured is concealed from view or made difficult to see, a plain synonym.

clue.text: An unknown in B&B all for playing it aggressively

blocks.note: the two B's of bed and breakfast
taken as written
algebra uses x, y and z for unknowns
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: BAZBALL is the nickname for England's attacking approach to Test cricket under coach Brendon 'Baz' McCullum.
explanation.definitionFit: The term names a style of cricket in which batters attack relentlessly, scoring fast regardless of match situation.

clue.text: Bargains here possibly offered by saloon-keeper?

definitions.text: Bargains here possibly offered by saloon-keeper?

blocks.note: surface reading: a landlord running a bar, selling cheap drinks
setter's reading: a saloon is a car, and the part that keeps its contents is the boot, from which goods are sold

explanation.walkthrough: A saloon is a British car body style, and a car-boot sale is an outdoor market where people sell junk from their car boots (trunks).
explanation.definitionFit: Such an event is where secondhand goods change hands cheaply, sold straight from parked vehicles.

clue.text: With second rook sacrificed, withdraw: join again?

clue.text: Clever swimmer left Greek character in Wear

clue.text: Cask tap very tight at first? Guzzler’s into that!

clue.text: Unusually courageous person beheaded — one charged?

clue.text: Nymph Echo stops wolf perhaps going after duck

clue.text: Uncompromising approach in Enduring Love?

clue.text: Scots sweetheart opening cold beer — get round?

clue.text: Husband cooked steak outside home: plate cooling?

taken as written, ready to be rearranged

clue.text: Outlaw what muggers may do to conceal themselves?

clue.text: Abnormally formed animal in gym — on steroids!
